description: Source code for Samsung's MFC (Multi-Format Codec) decoder API, including functions for opening, initializing, executing, and closing the decoder, as well as buffer management and tile-to-linear conversion routines.

methods.name: getAByte
methods.description: Reads a byte from buffer and updates the start code.

methods.name: isPBPacked
methods.description: Determines if the picture buffer is packed or unpacked by scanning stream buffer.

methods.name: SsbSipMfcDecOpen
methods.description: Opens and initializes the MFC decoder, maps device memory.

methods.name: SsbSipMfcDecInit
methods.description: Initializes the decoder with specified codec type and frame length.

methods.name: SsbSipMfcDecExe
methods.description: Executes decoding on input stream buffer.

methods.name: SsbSipMfcDecClose
methods.description: Closes decoder, frees buffers, unmaps memory.

methods.name: SsbSipMfcDecGetInBuf
methods.description: Allocates and returns input buffer for stream data.

methods.name: SsbSipMfcDecSetInBuf
methods.description: Sets physical and virtual input buffer addresses.

methods.name: SsbSipMfcDecGetOutBuf
methods.description: Retrieves output buffer information after decoding.

methods.name: tile_4x2_read
methods.description: Calculates tile read address for 4x2 tiled memory layout.

methods.name: Y_tile_to_linear_4x2
methods.description: Converts Y component from tiled to linear memory layout.

methods.name: CbCr_tile_to_linear_4x2
methods.description: Converts CbCr component from tiled to linear memory layout.
